name: Customer Discovery
title: Find local businesses faster
summary: A dedicated Discover page brings search, categories, filters and a smarter results ranking together in one place — with clean, shareable links for every district and category.

features: New Discover page (/discover) with a global search box, live suggestions, category browsing, and filters — reachable from Explore in the main navigation.
Search-as-you-type suggestions across businesses, categories and localities.
Category tiles show a short description and how many businesses are listed, so you know what you'll find before you tap in.
Filters for Open Now, Verified Businesses, Category and Locality, plus sort by Relevance, Rating, Newest or Open Now.
Every search is a shareable link — filters, sort and page are saved in the URL, so refreshing or sending a link keeps your results exactly as you left them.
Clean, direct links for browsing by category (e.g. /c/restaurants), by locality (e.g. /l/ludhiana), or both together.
improvements: Search results are now ranked by more than just featured status and star rating — verified businesses, complete profiles and businesses currently open now rise in relevance.
Business cards clearly show what you can do next — Book Appointment, Order Online, or View Profile & Call — instead of one generic button.
Business cards no longer show a star rating (we don't have customer reviews live yet, and we'd rather show nothing than a number that isn't real).
bugFixes: Fixed two 'Explore'-related links (main homepage footer) that previously did nothing when clicked.

impact.customers: Finding a trustworthy local business is now much faster — one search box with instant suggestions, filters for what matters (open now, verified), and results that surface better businesses first. Every search can be bookmarked or shared as a link.
impact.businesses: Better-maintained, verified, currently-open listings now rank higher automatically — completing your profile and staying verified directly improves how often you're seen. No action needed to benefit.
impact.platform: New reusable ranking pipeline and category metadata (descriptions, SEO keyword stubs, per-category business counts) lay the groundwork for future AI search, reviews-based ranking, and category landing pages — all addable later without redesigning search.

technicalChangelog: NEW src/services/ranking.service.js: extensible ranking pipeline (featured, trust/verified, profile completeness, open-now, membership tier, rating, recency providers); rankResults() re-ranks a result page in-memory after the DB's primary sort.
business.service.js: exported computeCompleteness (was module-private) for reuse by ranking.service.js — no duplicated logic.

search.service.js: added SORT_OPTIONS map (relevance/rating/newest/open_now) driving the DB orderBy; applies rankResults() only for the 'relevance' strategy; richer include (_count.reviews, _count.catalogItems) for future card/ranking use.

NEW src/modules/search/search.autocomplete.js + mounted GET /api/v1/search/autocomplete: businesses (DB, name match), categories (in-memory, from verticals.js), localities (DB, City.name — not the static district config, so finer-grained locality names resolve).

search.controller.js (getCategoriesController, mounts at /api/v1/search/categories): enriched top-level categories with `description`/`seo` (sourced from verticals.js, zero duplication) and rolled-up `businessCount` per category + subcategory via a cached prisma.businessCategory.groupBy.
verticals.js: added `description` (all 16 verticals) and a future-ready `seo: {color, keywords, metaTitle, metaDescription}` stub per CPO decision (structure now, content later).

app.js (Express): mounted /discover, /c/:categorySlug, /l/:locality, /:district/:category (serves discovery.html) and /business/:slug (301 -> /s/:slug). Declared after /api/v1 and with /business/:slug before the generic 2-segment wildcard to avoid route shadowing.

routes/v1/index.js: added a terminal 404 handler inside the v1 router so any unmatched /api/v1/* request can never fall through to the app-level page routes declared after it (caught a real edge case: bare GET /api/v1 was being served as a discovery page before this fix).

NEW src/public/discovery.html + src/public/js/discovery.js (self-contained, no shared globals with app.js/storefront.js — same architecture as the rest of public/js): parses filters from whichever URL booted it (path or querystring), renders category grid + district pills + filter sidebar + results grid, debounced autocomplete, URL-driven state via history.pushState (only after the first user interaction, so SEO entry URLs stay clean on first paint).

style.css: added discovery-specific classes (.discovery-*, .category-tile, .district-pill, .dc-*, .filter-sidebar, skeleton states) reusing existing design tokens (--primary/--accent/--bg-card/etc.) and the mobile drawer pattern already used elsewhere.

index.html + app.js: 'Explore' nav link and homepage search box now navigate to /discover (with locality/category/q pre-filled from the homepage search fields) instead of the legacy in-SPA search-results view.
index.html: fixed two footer links that called a never-defined `app.navigate(...)` (pre-existing dead code) — now point at /discover.
featureList: Ranking pipeline (ranking.service.js) — extensible scoring providers, not a hardcoded formula.
Category business-count + description enrichment on GET /search/categories.
Unified discovery engine: /discover, /c/:categorySlug, /l/:locality, /:district/:category all render the same page and treat filters identically.
Capability-driven card CTAs (Book Appointment / Order Online / View Profile & Call) replacing a single generic action.
bugFixList: Bare GET /api/v1 was incorrectly served by the new :district/:category wildcard — fixed with a terminal 404 inside the v1 router.
/business/:slug was being shadowed by the generic :district/:category wildcard (both 2-segment paths) — fixed by declaring the specific route first.
Two dead 'Explore'/'All Categories' footer links calling a non-existent app.navigate() — now valid /discover links.
improvementList: Search relevance now factors in verification, profile completeness and open-now status, not just featured + rating.

Discovery is reused-API-first: autocomplete's category bucket and the category grid both read from verticals.js (single source of truth); locality data reuses the existing /search/cities and City table rather than introducing a new locality data source.
internal.migrationNotes: None. No Prisma schema changes. All new fields (verticals.js description/seo, category enrichment) are computed at request time from existing tables and static config — nothing new to backfill.
internal.rollbackNotes: Revert app.js (route mounts + v1 router 404), search.service.js, search.controller.js, search.routes.js, verticals.js, index.html/app.js nav changes, and delete ranking.service.js, search.autocomplete.js, discovery.html, discovery.js, and the discovery CSS block in style.css. No data to unwind — everything is read-only/derived at request time.
